scope.description: One accepted subscription starting before an already compacted prefix, with a nonempty retained decided suffix, no concurrent changes to log decisions or compaction, and an actively drained subscriber.
assumptions: Valid fixed membership and reliable in-memory storage.
Unique entry values allow independent mapping of emitted entries to previously observed original log positions.
Runtime timers and channel receiver are driven.
excluded: No requirement to re-emit individual entries removed by compaction.
No claim that a snapshot marker is itself an ordinary single-position entry.
No deadline or unbounded eventual-delivery claim.

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: No target modifications or injected protocol/storage state.
Test Entry has a snapshot that stores and concatenates the represented prefix values.
Public AsyncRuntime hooks use real Tokio spawn and timers.

plan_uncertainties: A bounded prefix with no reversal would not settle all possible future schedules.
No claim about duplicate markers, missing compacted values or stream liveness.
The requirement concerns consumption order, not agreement among replica logs.
grounding_unresolved: Need actual stream observations to establish whether cursor interpretation produces a reversal.
Finite output observation establishes order only for the completed window; no inference of unbounded progress or deadline compliance.
No completion of the unbounded stream is claimed; the result is a safety comparison over the observed finite prefix.
